levels.description: Gain Raw Assimilation: in battle, eat an ingredient (1 AP) for a buff a third as strong as the potions it goes into.

effects.name: Raw Assimilation
effects.description: In battle, eat an ingredient from the item menu for 1 AP: a buff made from the potions it goes into (the two strongest kinds of effect), a third as strong as they are, lasting 2 turns (common), 3 (uncommon, rare) or 4 (epic, legendary). An ingredient only in poisons puts the poison on your weapon hits instead. The same ingredient again refreshes its buff; different ingredients add up.

levels.description: Raw Assimilation buffs are half as strong as their potions and last 1 turn longer.

effects.description: Half as strong as the potions, 1 turn longer.

levels.description: Eating an ingredient has a 25% chance not to use it up.
Raw Assimilation buffs are two-thirds as strong as their potions and carry their special effects too (AP, rising again, immunities, cures).

effects.description: Two-thirds as strong as the potions, special effects included.
